scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final
other_conditions: Student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Parents should reside in Andhra Pradesh
Student must have cleared both groups of CA‑Inter (IPCC) after 2014 and must be registered and have paid fees for the CA Final exam
Student must not have previously benefited from Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation for the CA Final exam
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 for the Chartered Accountancy Final course.
